title: ATEEZ Ready For Their Close-Up in Intense Teaser For ‘ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS’: Watch
summary: The latest movie experience from the K-pop group will hit theaters worldwide on Aug. 6 and 8.
contentText:
ATEEZ are headed back to the big screen. The eight-man K-pop boy band released a thirty-second summer blockbuster-style trailer for their upcoming theatrical release on Monday morning (July 6), promising to bring the heat in premium sound and high-def visuals.

ATEEZ : LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS , the follow-up to the group’s 2025 big screen effort, ATEEZ WORLD TOUR [TOWARDS THE LIGHT : WILL TO POWER] IN CINEMAS , is slated to hit screens worldwide on Aug. 6 and 8. Making use of AMAZE’s immersive VR technology — which toured select cities around the globe in 2025 and this year — the film will reimagine the group’s performances in super high-def 8K resolution and 5.1 surround sound, letting ATINY experience “an intense, big-screen immersion featuring powerful live tracking of the group’s global hits,” according to a release.

Fans will hear such hits as “INCEPTION,” “BOUNCY (K-HOT CHILLI PEPPERS)” and “Ice On My Teeth,” alongside 20 minutes of exclusive, never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage available only in theaters. Local exhibitors will also have exclusive photocard fan gifts for distribution at theaters.

“One day, a mysterious message arrives for ATEEZ, who had been spending a peaceful time in their hideout. At that moment, everything began to change,” reads a synopsis. “ATINY has vanished … As if under a spell, ATEEZ wanders through a dreamlike wasteland, into a collapsing world engulfed in flames, and the Dark City veiled in dense fog. Pursued by an unknown force, ATEEZ begins to fight back to find ATINY.”

The dramatic trailer cued to the band’s 2021 single “Deja Vu” delivers on that moody premise, with Yunho, Seonghwa, Mingi, San, Yeosang, Hongjoong, Wooyoung and Jongho doing an intense dance with red fabric clenched between their teeth and pulling out some high-tech weapons in the VR concert that has been refitted for cinemas.

“We are excited to collaborate with the AMAZE team to bring a reimagined version of their innovative ATEEZ VR concert experience to cinemas worldwide,” said Trafalgar Releasing CEO Marc Allenby in a statement. “With ATEEZ’s proven success in cinemas, we believe this new presentation, featuring exclusive behind-the-scenes sequences, will offer fans a fresh way to connect with the group on a truly cinematic scale.”

Tickets for the screenings are on sale here now .

ATEEZ snagged their third No. 1 on the Billboard 200 albums chart with their new collection GOLDEN HOUR : PART.5 , which tops the tally dated July 11.
